## Install

**Which file:** download **`Deskbase-Setup-{version}.exe`** below. It is the only one you need, for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). The other two files (`latest.yml` and `.blockmap`) are used by automatic updates.

1. Download `Deskbase-Setup-{version}.exe`.
2. Open it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway** (the installer isn't code-signed).
3. Click **Next**, keep or change the folder, then **Install**.
4. Leave **Run Deskbase** ticked and click **Finish**.

**Already installed?** Nothing to download: Deskbase updates itself in the background and installs the new version the next time it restarts.
